value.rationale: A natural, unbounded graph invariant (girth) and the weighted number of shortest cycles are determined exactly by the distribution of one aggregate geometric overlap statistic. This structural leading-order law holds for all finite simple graphs and ambient dimensions and provides explicit qubit short-cycle tomography. It is not an arbitrary parameter slice, a known-table lookup, or a finite experimental pattern; the model and invariant are motivated by random-state overlap and random-spin geometry.
